summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue by resolving SimpleLazyObject before converting it to an integer, but introduces some complexity and potential fragility.

issues.description: The approach of forcing evaluation of SimpleLazyObject by calling `str(value)` is somewhat fragile and may not work for all types of lazy objects. It also adds complexity to the `get_prep_value` method.
The addition of comments could improve readability, but the current implementation is understandable.
